frozen_before: any dev metric of any predictor, and the top-up's collection; any training past 30 epochs with the fall term; any latent result with the frozen structure
already_seen: train-side results only: reports/WO-014-m1-cube-prediction-diagnosis.md and section 4 of reports/WO-004-m1-predictors-and-calibration.md, including ET-M1-3's measures pooled over horizons on train holdouts. Those measures per horizon have not been computed for any model.
final_variant_decided_by: the rules in evals/M1-family-holdouts.json, applied in the report

data.fit: the 234 train episodes with seeds not divisible by 10, the split every earlier result used
data.calibration: the 26 train episodes with seeds divisible by 10, never fitted on
data.dev: the 60 dev episodes of artifacts/manifests/m0-dataset-v1.json plus the 150 of evals/M1-dev-topup-plan.json
data.sealed: none exists in M1 and none is touched

epochs_rule.comparison: carry-contact-beta-fall at 100 epochs, seeds 0, 1 and 2, holding out in turn the seed holdout, m0-scripted-early-release and m0-scripted-missed-grasp, on train data
epochs_rule.against: the same at 30 epochs: runs/20261102T035805Z_ddb5d0d0 for the seed holdout and runs/20261102T041509Z_93dd348c for the two families
epochs_rule.value: the worst value, taking the worst seed, horizon and required stream, with the same five baselines
epochs_rule.rule: Use 100 epochs only if the worst value is higher at 100 than at 30 on all three holdouts. Otherwise use 30, because the seed holdout's 30-epoch models are already measured and a longer run that helps one holdout and hurts another gives no reason to prefer it.

final_models: the seed-holdout ensembles trained at the chosen epochs, one per seed. No retraining on the 26 calibration episodes.
baselines_note: evals/M1-definitions.json names the nominal inside the learned predictor, here nominal_carry_fall. The other two nominals are also counted, because every nominal tested so far counts. This can only make ET-M1-1 harder.

ET-M1-1.rule: evals/M1-definitions.json, unchanged, for the ensemble on each of the three seeds: joint_position and object_position, each in own units, at every horizon 1 to 10, at least 20% below the lowest baseline. Decided on the point estimates. Passing needs all three seeds, so the worst seed decides.
ET-M1-1.reported_with_it: a 95% interval on each reduction from resampling whole episodes, which does not decide the test; object_grasped, report-only; every dev family and phase, report-only

ET-M1-3.decided_by: owner, 2026-11-01: freeze ET-M1-3's streams the same way as ET-M1-1. The per-horizon reading below is the agent's, the stricter of the two, and made without having seen any per-horizon value.

streams_excluded.object_grasped: a flag: its error is not a continuous quantity an interval describes
streams_excluded.target_position: it never moves within an episode

ET-M1-3.predicted_std: the square root of the mean predicted variance of the members plus the variance of the members' means, for the ensemble's mean
ET-M1-3.calibration: one scale per stream and horizon: the split-conformal 90% quantile of absolute error over predicted std, on the 26 calibration episodes, per seed. Dev is never used to fit it.
ET-M1-3.spearman_rule: Spearman rank correlation, with tied ranks averaged, of predicted std against absolute error, pooled over all dev windows and the stream's coordinates, at least 0.5 at every horizon 1 to 10, on all three seeds. A per-horizon scale cannot change this rank.
ET-M1-3.coverage_rule: The share of absolute errors within the calibrated scale times predicted std is within 10 points of 90% at every horizon 1 to 10, on all three seeds.
ET-M1-3.reported_with_it: uncalibrated 90% coverage at z = 1.6449; both measures pooled over horizons; Spearman by coordinate. None decides the test.

latent.model: src/vishwaroop/models/latent_predictor.py: a recurrent state-space model on state observations, with observation-update and imagination modes, its decoder giving the residual over the same nominal structure
latent.role: Report-only on dev, with the same tables. It decides no exit test, so dev does not choose between two predictors.
latent.scope_note: It satisfies M1's compact latent predictor (owner, 2026-11-01). The visual version is WO-013.

use_of_dev.scored_once: src/vishwaroop/models/m1_evaluate.py scores once and refuses a second scoring once one has completed.
use_of_dev.after_a_miss: A miss is reported as a miss. No model, epoch, calibration or threshold is changed on evidence from dev under this work order. Trying again needs a new work order, with the owner told first.
